```bash
p7c load --list -v
```

## Flag Explanation

The `-v` (or `--verbose`) flag enables **detailed diagnostic output** for each loaded module, showing:

| Detail | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Module name & version | Identifies the module and its loaded version |
| Source path | Absolute filesystem path to the `.p7m` file |
| Load timestamp | When the module was loaded into the runtime |
| Dependencies | Other modules this one depends on |
| Memory footprint | Approximate RAM usage |
| Config params | Any runtime-configured options |

Without `-v`, `p7c load --list` only shows a bare list of module names.
